name: security-jwt-fallback-secret
description: Multi-file Express/TS auth PR that (1) introduces a hardcoded JWT-secret fallback bypassing the zod-validated env contract in src/config/env.ts, (2) logs the issued access token in plaintext in the login route, (3) compares refresh tokens via `===` instead of constant-time equality (timing attack), and (4) calls `crypto.randomBytes` without importing the `crypto` module — a real correctness bug only visible if the reviewer sees the file's import block, not just the hunk.

expected.description: Hardcoded fallback secret `dev-fallback-secret-do-not-use-in-prod` bypasses the zod-validated JWT_SECRET contract. Any environment that forgets the env var silently signs+verifies tokens with a publicly-known string.
`stored.token === presented` is a non-constant-time comparison on a refresh-token secret. Should use `crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(stored.token), Buffer.from(presented))` after length-check.
`crypto.randomBytes(...)` is called but the file's import block (lines 1–3) never imports `crypto`. Runtime ReferenceError on every refresh. Visible only with full-file context.

`logger.info("...token=${token}")` writes the freshly-signed access token to the application log at INFO level. Anyone with log access (oncall, log aggregator, ops) can impersonate the user for 15 minutes.
